Each Grafcet is transformed into a PetriNet.

The location of the Grafcet is copied to the location of the PetriNet.

The name of the Grafcet is copied to the name of the PetriNet.

The elements of the Grafcet are copied to the elements of the PetriNet.

The connections of the Grafcet are copied to the arcs of the PetriNet.

Each Step is transformed into a Place.

The location of the Step is copied to the location of the Place.

The name of the Step is copied to the name of the Place.

The grafcet of the Step is copied to the net of the Place.

The incomingConnections of the Step are copied to the incomingArc of the Place.

The outgoingConnections of the Step are copied to the outgoingArc of the Place.

Each StepToTransition is transformed into a PlaceToTransition.

The from reference of the StepToTransition is copied to the from reference of the PlaceToTransition.

The to reference of the StepToTransition is copied to the to reference of the PlaceToTransition.

Each TransitionToStep is transformed into a TransitionToPlace.

The from reference of the TransitionToStep is copied to the from reference of the TransitionToPlace.

The to reference of the TransitionToStep is copied to the to reference of the TransitionToPlace.
